description: As the Product Manager for Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM) , you will own the product strategy and execution for Percona's open source observability platform for databases. You will work closely with engineering, design, product leadership, customers, and the open source community to define the future of PMM. This is a highly technical product role. Our users are database administrators, SREs, platform engineers, DevOps engineers, cloud engineers, and developers who rely on PMM to monitor and optimize mission-critical database environments. We're looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who enjoys moving quickly, talking to customers, validating ideas early, and iterating rapidly. This is not a role where you'll spend months writing specifications before shipping. We value experimentation, pragmatism, and delivering customer value. What Will You Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for PMM, ensuring it aligns with Percona's overall product vision. Work directly with customers and the community to understand their challenges, validate ideas, and identify new product opportunities. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to help shape product direction. Translate customer problems into clear product requirements and priorities. Work closely with Engineering, Design, Documentation, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver outstanding product experiences. Prioritize features and make informed trade-offs based on customer value, engineering effort, and strategic goals. Define success metrics and use customer feedback, product telemetry, and usage data to guide product decisions. Collaborate closely with engineering throughout the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to release. Represent PMM internally and externally through blog posts, webinars, conferences, customer meetings, and community engagement. Help drive the adoption of PMM across the open source community and enterprise organizations. What You Have Done Proven success managing technical products, particularly developer tools, infrastructure, platform, or observability products. Demonstrated experience shipping successful software products from idea to release. Strong technical understanding of modern infrastructure, databases, cloud-native, and observability technologies, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into product strategy and customer value. Experience working cross-functionally across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success. Strong customer empathy with the ability to translate customer problems into products that deliver real value. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, making decisions with incomplete information, and iterating quickly based on customer feedback. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. Fluent in English. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer visits, conferences, and company events. What Will Make You Stand Out Experience with observability technologies such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, VictoriaMetrics, or similar platforms. Experience with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or other data platforms. Experience with Kubernetes, Linux, cloud-native technologies, and distributed systems. Experience working with open source communities as an active contributor or community member. Experience building products for developers, SREs, platform engineers, DevOps engineers, database administrators, or other highly technical users. Experience defining AI-powered workflows, developer productivity tools, or AI-assisted observability experiences. Experience working in startups or high-growth companies where rapid iteration, experimentation, and customer feedback drive product decisions. Comfortable taking ownership and wearing multiple hats in a small, collaborative team. Passion for open source and building products in close partnership with engineering and the community. Why Percona? At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB. Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard. Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology. If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk! Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

description: As a Business Management Analyst, you will support the Business Management team in the smooth running of the Global Lending organisation. You will help turn information into insight, coordinate key management activities, and contribute to communications and initiatives that support effective decision-making and keep priorities moving forward. Based in Dublin, this role offers broad exposure to a global organisation and is ideal for an organised, curious and proactive analyst who enjoys learning how a global business is managed, takes ownership and can balance attention to detail with the bigger picture. The team ING Wholesale Banking is a leading global bank with a strong European base, serving clients in 35 markets across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, the Americas and Asia Pacific. Within Wholesale Banking, Global Lending provides specialised lending, corporate finance, sustainable finance and related solutions to clients across ING’s international network. You will join the Business Management team supporting the Global Lending organisation, working directly with senior Business Managers, the Global Head of Lending and executive assistants. In this immediate team, you will help connect strategy and execution by supporting business planning, governance, management reporting, communications and the coordination of key initiatives across the Lending domain. You will also collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, Communications, Risk, COO and Transformation, giving you broad exposure to how Global Lending operates across ING’s international network. Roles and responsibilities You will support the Business Management team across business performance, management support, communications and operational excellence, helping to keep priorities visible, decisions documented and activities moving forward across the Global Lending organisation. Collect, consolidate and analyse information to support senior leadership decision-making. Prepare management reporting, presentations, briefing materials and updates for key stakeholders. Monitor business performance indicators and track progress against priorities, actions and decisions. Support the preparation and follow-up of management meetings, steering committees, townhalls and offsites. Maintain key governance documents, records and team repositories to support a well-organised operating environment. Coordinate specific initiatives involving multiple stakeholders across Wholesale Banking, including Finance, HR, Communications, Risk, COO and Transformation teams. Draft internal communications, organisational announcements and management updates for the Lending organisation. Identify opportunities to improve ways of working, documentation quality and process efficiency. How to succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. Bring strong analytical skills and the ability to work confidently with information from multiple sources. Communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior audiences. Work in an organised and detail-oriented way, keeping track of actions, deadlines and deliverables. Show curiosity, resilience and proactivity in a fast-paced international environment. Engage confidently with stakeholders across different levels and functions, building trusted working relationships. Confident use of the Microsoft suite including PowerPoint, Excel, and Copilot to structure thinking, create insights and support decision-making. Rewards and benefits We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. The benefits of working with us at ING include: 23–28 days of annual leave depending on level, increasing with tenure A defined contribution pension scheme with employer contributions and matching options A discretionary annual bonus A €1,720 annual health insurance allowance A hybrid working model based in our Dublin office A 35-hour working week supporting work-life balance Personal growth and challenging work with career development potential to grow within Business Management or the wider WB organisation. Exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making. Broad insight into Lending and the wider Wholesale Banking organisation. About us Curious about how ING empowers people and businesses to move forward? Discover what we do and what we can offer you. Questions? Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.

description: Who We Are Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com. While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions. The Challenge The Product Manager, Marketing Innovation & Technology role is based in Dublin and plays a critical part in leading the evolution of our Marketing Technology stack. The role emphasizes delivering significant value to our labels, under the umbrella of our parent company. We work alongside the Label’s (2K, Zynga, and Rockstar Games) Marketing, Live-Services and CX teams, leading and supporting the underlying technology stack used to enhance Marketing capabilities and measurement, in order to improve the player experience. The primary purpose of the role is to enable and further empower these teams to do what they do best – produce outstanding content and meaningfully engage players. As a critical partner on an integrated team that includes Marketing Intelligence and Player Data & Tech, your responsibilities will include managing the entire technology lifecycle - from interpreting business needs (known or discovered) through delivery, evangelization, and support. This role requires an acute understanding of Marketing & Technology platforms, experience leading complex cross-functional programs - serving as a bridge between business partners, vendors, and other collaborators. What You’ll Take On PRODUCT STRATEGY & DEVELOPMENT Analyze business needs and identity product opportunities across the business for products solutions within the marketing technology domain - prioritizing value creation, usability, viability, and feasibility Formulate product requirements and author associated documentation (PRDs) that designate priority features and establish the product roadmap Partner with engineering and other supporting teams to determine technical feasibility, prioritize features, and ensure implementation of requirements Drive product evangelism and adoption of solutions tracking back to appropriate product or business metrics (both quantitative & qualitative for new or existing products) Define and execute a multi-year strategy to unify the player experience across marketing, support, and commerce sites using our enterprise CMS as the core headless orchestrator. Lead the strategy to funnel web behavioral data and consent signals into our CDP, ensuring a single source of truth for player identity. Develop the product requirements for moving from static segmentation to real-time, data-driven hyper-personalization powered by CDP attributes and AI-driven content assembly. RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT Establish strategic relationships with Marketing, technology, and data leaders across the labels Develop relationships with the right Vendors and other supporting teams within Take-Two - bringing them together to solve problems quickly Define the features and benefits of technology solutions and ensure they are appropriately communicated to all partners Act as the primary bridge between Marketing, Customer Support, and E-commerce leads to ensure a consistent brand voice and functional parity across all web touchpoints. Manage strategic partnerships ensuring our roadmap stays ahead of vendor partner product releases and negotiating service levels that support our high-growth needs. INNOVATION AND VALUE GENERATION Develop roadmaps and multi-year plans, and lead from idea to implementation Focus on operational management and innovation, with a strong emphasis on generating value Stay current with emerging technology and strategies used to support the customer experience and present findings regularly Envision the future and elevate our capabilities to inspire and create a competitive advantage Lead the implementation and maturation of AI agents within the stack to automate metadata tagging, SEO, and proactive compliance monitoring. OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE Take lead on improving team processes including procurement, budgeting, enablement & support, and compliance Establish and maintain efficient processes for product development and delivery Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance team productivity and product quality Ensure consent management platform is deeply integrated into the development lifecycle, automating global privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA) without degrading site performance or player experience. Establish and enforce global tagging standards and data taxonomies in web engagement platforms to ensure the unified player records are built on clean, high-fidelity data. Drive the internal adoption of new tools and AI features, providing training and documentation to ensure marketing and content teams are utilizing the stack to its full potential. What You Bring As a Product Manager you demonstrate mastery of execution, solving ambiguous problems that support the strategy. You own outcomes in support of product strategy with accountability for both execution and direction of those projects. You define and launch product solutions for more complex user needs (player, marketer, partner). 3-5 years of practical experience developing and driving solutions powered by technology. Solid understanding of digital advertising, customer journey orchestration, and data architecture Proven experience developing & implementing technology-powered solutions across AdTech, CRM, and Lifecycle management platforms. Strong background in digital innovation, preferably experience in the interactive entertainment industry. Ability to establish and navigate high-level relationships. Outstanding communication and skills and ability to position & advocate up to executive leadership. Demonstrated ability in designing and building metrics (e.g. acquisition, engagement, retention, etc.) to showcase value production & impact. Practical experience of budgeting, contract management, and compliance in a tech environment. Demonstrates strong creativity and scrappiness and can handle constraints with grace. Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts & solutions across a range of detail depending on audience, and via appropriate media (i.e., presentation vs. doc). What We Offer You Great Company Culture. We pride ourselves as being one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success. Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company. Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees’ bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, our onsite Gym, company parties, our Office bar, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges. Benefits include, but are not limited to Private healthcare, Private dental, pension plan, Cycle to work scheme, Flu vouchers, Annual health, 4X death in service insurance, Income protection (66% salary), Workplace Savings, 22 days holiday, Enhanced Family friendly policies + other great perks and great office facilities! Perks. Fitness reimbursement up to €45 per month, employee discount programs, free games & events, and stocked pantries. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (“T2”) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment at T2 is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Take-Two’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a take2games.com email domain). description: Join the Future of EdTech with Learnosity Power the future of learning worldwide with Learnosity Learnosity is looking for bright minds to help bring AI magic to real-world learning. We're looking for exceptional engineers, product thinkers, designers, data scientists, researchers, and AI specialists who want to do career-defining work with global impact. Who we are Learnosity is the global leader in assessment solutions. We provide experiences that are digital, dynamic, and designed to meet the needs of modern learners to test and prove knowledge. Our technology powers assessment for hundreds of organizations of all sizes and reaches over 40 million learners every year. And we want you to help drive our next wave of AI-led innovations. Why Join Us? Visibility & Influence : Operate in an environment where there's minimal distance between ideas and decision-making, with direct access to senior leadership and the ability to shape meaningful outcomes. Pragmatic Innovation : Help shape how AI and other new technologies are applied where they deliver genuine value. Build & Scale : Help shape new products while leveraging the platform, customers, and reach of an established global business. Real Impact : Build systems and products that directly influence how millions of learners are assessed and supported worldwide. Ownership & Collaboration : Take responsibility for your work while collaborating with experienced, thoughtful teammates across engineering, product, and design. Growth & Development : Develop your career in an environment that values continuous learning, leadership and long-term growth. If you're motivated by building meaningful products at scale, and want to improve how people learn worldwide, we'd love to hear from you. Help Build the Future of Workforce Learning Learnosity powers digital assessment and learning experiences for more than 40 million learners worldwide. Now we're expanding into workforce learning. As a Product Manager, you'll play a key role in launching Learnosity Workforce (LWF), a new platform designed to help organisations build, deliver, and measure workforce learning experiences. You'll work across both our established Build platform and our emerging Workforce platform, helping shape products that create value for customers today while defining what's next. If you're excited by the combination of platform scale, product innovation, and AI-enabled product development, we'd love to hear from you. Why This Role Matters This isn't a maintenance role. You'll help deliver the platform capabilities that underpin the successful launch and growth of Learnosity Workforce, while leveraging the scale, maturity, and reach of Learnosity's core platform. You'll work across multiple product domains, influence strategic decisions, and help create products used by organisations around the world. Quick Facts Hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in our Dublin office) Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Team: Product - Build & Learnosity Workforce Reports to: VP Product, Australia Regular collaboration with colleagues in multiple time zones in Australia and North America Public API and platform-focused product environment AI-enabled product development practices embedded across the organisation What You'll Achieve In Your First 12 Months Deliver key capabilities required for the successful launch and adoption of Learnosity Workforce. Shape product experiences that serve both workforce customers and developer audiences. Partner with Engineering and Design teams to bring new features from discovery through delivery. Establish strong customer feedback loops and use product insights to influence roadmap decisions. Help define how AI-powered product development practices are adopted across Product teams. Build trusted relationships across Build, Workforce, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support teams. A Typical Week Might Include Working with engineers and designers to refine upcoming platform capabilities. Reviewing customer feedback, usage data, and product performance metrics. Collaborating with Product leaders across Build and Workforce on roadmap priorities. Presenting feature updates and product demonstrations to stakeholders. Using AI tools to accelerate discovery, planning, and product delivery activities. Conducting customer discovery interviews to understand workforce learning challenges. You'll Work With Public APIs and developer platforms Product discovery and customer research methodologies AI-assisted product development workflows Cross-functional Product, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success teams Platform products serving both technical and non-technical users Requirements What We're Looking For Essential 3+ years of Product Management experience or similar product-focused experience. Experience working with APIs, platform products, or developer-focused products. Strong product judgement and ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities. Technical literacy and understanding of modern web applications. Experience working with mature software products operating at scale. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong AI literacy and enthusiasm for AI-enabled ways of working. Nice To Have Experience in EdTech, workforce learning, or learning and development. Experience building products for technical audiences. Accessibility experience or a passion for inclusive product design. Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments. Benefits Generous annual, parental and sick leave Health and dental insurance Pension contributions Learning and development support Employee Assistance Program Flexible work practices Commuter benefits Modern city-centre office Our Values We are a values-driven company, and how we work matters as much as what we build: We live to learn We aim higher We do the right thing Our success is better shared Ready to Apply? Apply with your CV. We aim to keep our hiring process straightforward, transparent, and respectful of your time. Find out more about your career at Learnosity at learnosity.com/careers/ Please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy Salary & package dependent on experience. Please only contact us if you are a candidate interested in applying for this role. You must have the right to live and work in Ireland to apply.
